snippet.title: Undertale Yellow: Shades of Justice Mod Trailer
snippet.description:
*GAMEJOLT*
https://www.gamejolt.com/games/UTY_shadesofjustice/935169
*GAMEBANANA*
https://gamebanana.com/mods/556303

*Undertale Yellow: Shades of Justice* is a mod for *Undertale Yellow* that expands upon the Pacifist Route by providing new character interactions and a twist to the follower system!

*FEATURES*
- New sprites, animations and music
- Followers can now *ACT* and provide new buffs in combat
- *Dalv* can now accompany Clover on their journey through Snowdin
- You can talk to him in every room for his thoughts, just like with Martlet and Ceroba in the base game
- *Martlet* can also go with Clover through the Dunes from the very start, complete with brand new dialogue and interactions
- *Hang out with Dalv and Martlet* before completing your journey, just like with Papyrus, Undyne and Alphys in Undertale
- Huh? Starlo and Axis? Well, maybe next update, ok?
- Ok, well, Axis *DOES* have some new stuff; sorry Starlo fans!
- Brand new dialogue in existing scenes
- Some bugs fixed that were left from the base game
- A new FUN value event
- And…
- A new secret boss…?

*CREDITS*
Trailer by Audrey: https://bsky.app/profile/slop.bsky.social
Thumbnail by Sturner: https://twitter.com/Sturnerart
Spritework by Doru1: https://twitter.com/IamDoru1
Undertale Yellow by Team UTY: https://gamejolt.com/games/UndertaleYellow/136925

If you have any help, feedback, suggestions, complaints or criticisms, feel free to DM me on my socials or comment down below!
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ZenderTroop
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/zendertroop.bsky.social
